claims.evidence: Four independent experiments (#1-#4) on two MS platforms (thesis 3.1.2: "Four independent experiments on two different MS platforms were performed"). In each, one HCV-infected and one uninfected Huh7.5 SILAC culture were mixed in equal cell numbers and LDs isolated. Deposit file prefixes SILAC1..SILAC4 = experiments #1..#4 (see orientation claim). One source name per physical culture per experiment (8 sources); the LD isolate is the 1:1 mixture of the two, distinguished by comment[label].

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[infection status] + factor value[infection status] rows 1-88 (SILAC1-3)
claims.value: SILAC light = HCV-infected, SILAC heavy = uninfected control
claims.evidence: Thesis Fig 3.3 legend: "in #1-#3 HCV-infected cells were cultured in light amino acids and control cells in heavy amino acids; in #4 culturing conditions were switched"; Fig 3.2 legend and JoVE Fig 1A: cells carrying light amino acids were infected. Data check (orientation.txt): SILAC1 Table S1 "Mean filtered" log2 = thesis #1 + 0.391 for 100% of 316 proteins (+-0.05); SILAC2 MaxQuant -log2(H/L) = #2 + const for 99%; SILAC3 -log2(H/L) = #3 + const for 100% (Pearson -1.000) -> deposited ratios are infected/control with infected = light. Marker: ANXA3 (enriched at LDs of infected cells, abstract) median-centred log2 H/L SILAC2 -1.89, SILAC3 -1.04 (higher in light).

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[infection status] + factor value[infection status] rows 89-108 (SILAC4)
claims.value: SILAC heavy = HCV-infected, SILAC light = uninfected control (label swap)
claims.evidence: Thesis Fig 3.3 legend "#4 culturing conditions were switched"; 3.1.2: "one experiment was performed with HCV-infected cells labeled with heavy amino acids mixed together with naive cells cultured in media containing light amino acids". Data: SILAC4 +log2(H/L) = thesis #4 + 1.072 for 99% of 316 proteins; ANXA3 median-centred log2 H/L +1.50.

claims.evidence: Each experiment used independently cultured/infected cells ("cells from different passages and different virus stock preparations", JoVE; four independent experiments, thesis); numbering restarts per factor group, one number per independent culture.

limitations: Paper full text (Cell Reports, CC BY-NC-ND) not retrievable: cell.com and sciencedirect return Cloudflare/403 bot checks (not bypassed), no PMC copy, CORE full text withheld. Design/label facts come from the first author's dissertation (same experiments, Table S1 reproduces the deposited ratios exactly) and the JoVE protocol (PMC5564943).
Experiment-to-deposit mapping SILAC1..4 = thesis #1..#4 established numerically (orientation.txt) rather than stated in text.

Per-experiment reporter construct (Jc1NS5AB-mKO2-BSD vs Jc1NS5AB-eGFP) and blasticidin selection ("in one half of the experiments") are not assigned to experiments in any source; strain written generically as "Jc1 NS5AB reporter virus".

SILAC1 search parameters (OpenMS 1.9 TOPPAS, OMSSA + X!Tandem) are not deposited; modification parameters for rows 1-44 are inferred from modifications present in the deposited identification exports. Tolerances are from the PRIDE protocol.
SILAC1 technical replicate 2 (bands 4-7, "_lang" runs of 2013-08-26) interpreted from file names as re-injections of the same gel bands.
Collision energy: raw method headers (35% SILAC2, 30% SILAC3/4) disagree with the thesis text (28%); raw values used. SILAC2 MS1 scan range ambiguous in the raw header -> not available.
Waters SILAC1 raw archives (0.5-1.5 GB 7z) were not opened; Q-Tof Premier comes from PRIDE and the thesis.
reduction reagent not named in any source -> not available; alkylation reagent inferred from carbamidomethylation and the cited Shevchenko in-gel protocol.
sdrf-tools cellline lookup mis-resolved "Huh-7.5" to Huh-7 (CVCL_0336); corrected from Cellosaurus API (CVCL_7927).
